notes: OAK-D Pro W (installed 2026-09-25). camera_height_m 0.213 is the caliper-measured lens centre (21.2-21.4 cm; housing bottom 19.4-19.5 cm). camera_pitch_deg is the angle between the camera axis and THE FLOOR IT IS REJECTING, so it absorbs both mount tolerance and local floor slope -- re-run src/floor_plane_validate.py after any move, including a translation on the same floor. Measured 2026-09-25 on lab carpet with 4.5 m of clear floor, on depth corrected by config/oak_depth_correction.json: -0.308 and -0.271 deg (nose UP), fit RMS 1.3/0.9 mm. The earlier -1.044 was fitted to uncorrected depth, which reads long and mimics a nose-up pitch. The BNO086 reads ~-1.1 deg, i.e. it sits ~0.85 deg off the optical axis on this unit, so do not calibrate pitch from the IMU. Roll is NOT modelled by the single-pitch height equation.
